name: Fee-Free TAFE Queensland
summary: Tuition-free priority courses at TAFE Queensland or CQUniversity for eligible Queenslanders, now including construction.
key: Fee-Free TAFE, extended until 31 December 2026, allows eligible Queenslanders to study priority skill sets and qualifications.
who: Australian or NZ citizen, permanent resident, or eligible temporary resident on a pathway to permanent residency.
15 or older and no longer at school.
Not currently enrolled in a qualification (foundation skills excepted).
Not already completed a Fee-Free TAFE or Free Nursing qualification.
how: Enrol through TAFE Queensland (1300 308 233) or CQUniversity (13 27 86).
catches: Only one qualification under Fee-Free TAFE or Free Nursing.
Uniforms and resources may still cost extra.
Extended until 31 December 2026; fee-free construction applies to students who start before 31 December.

evidence.quote: Fee-Free TAFE, extended until 31 December 2026, allows eligible Queenslanders to study priority skill sets and qualifications, providing opportunities to upskill, reskill or start a career in high-demand industries.
Fee-free construction is now available as part of fee-free TAFE for students who start training before 31 December.
